name: RAC3-style health
author: Lanana420
description: Going Commando's health as a number, as in Ratchet & Clank 3: you start with 10 and reach 200 with every level and boost, and in place of the health segments a box like the ammo box shows 'health/max' with a gauge. Enemy hits and nanotech grow with it, and later planets hit a little harder. Off by default; turn it on in the mods list.

settings.name: Later planets hit harder
settings.description: Enemy hits grow from the first planet to the last, up to 30% more. Off: every hit takes the same share of your health as in the original game.
